summary: Excited circles the middle fingers of both open hands up the chest, alternating, with bright, eager eyes.
handshape: Open hands with the middle finger bent in (5 hands)
steps: Bend the middle finger of each open hand slightly inward.
Brush the middle fingertips up your chest in alternating circles.
Eyes wide, eyebrows up, a little bounce in your body.
mistakes: Using flat hands brushing up together. That's HAPPY. EXCITED uses the middle fingers and alternates.
